notes: The session's web search allowance was already used up (200 of 200) before this part began, so no search was made. Findings come from addresses read directly: the campaign websites the candidates filed with the Secretary of State (already in sl_websites, read from the database read-only), the Minnesota DFL's endorsed page, and each government's own site, reached from its home page. Pages were read with the kit's reader (honest User-Agent, robots.txt obeyed) or the fetch tool. Candidates with no findings are the ones this left out of reach.

Huldah Momanyi-Hiltsley (a sitting legislator): the website she filed, https://huldahforhouse.com, answered the kit's reader with 429 three times and the fetch tool could not find the host, so no website is recorded; it was not asked again.

Not holders according to the government's own page, so nothing recorded: Dennis Pletcher (Lake of the Woods County lists James "Buck" Nordlof for District 1), Jeff Gontarek (Otter Tail County lists Wayne D. Johnson for District 2), Christian Rider (not on Lakeville's council page), Morgan Baum (Hutchinson's council profiles list Tim Burley in Seat 1), Misty Bray (Bemidji lists Emelie Rivera for Ward 4). Joe Landherr and Jaime Guardado Jr. are not named on the Mower and Pipestone County board pages.
Reed Reinbold: the county's own page shows no elected or appointed office for him, so nothing is recorded.

Left alone: the City of Cambridge's site answered 403 (Bob Shogren); Hastings Public Schools' board page is on a host whose robots.txt asks scripts to stay out (Mark A. Zuzek); the Minnesota Judicial Branch refuses scripts, as earlier parts found, and was not asked (Paul J. Gunderson). The City of Mounds View's council page names no one (Julia Wolff). No working address was found for the City of Detroit Lakes (Zachary J Foltz) or for a Cloquet school board page (Daniel Lee). The Minneapolis DFL's home page links no 2026 school board endorsement page (Ben Lattimore). No campaign website was found for Gadisa Berkessa or Jennifer Compeau: the party's page links only a donation page.

Privacy: while checking the St. Cloud school district's board page, the reader's printout around the name showed two street addresses that the district prints beside its members (the script masks e-mail and phone numbers, not street addresses). Nothing from it was stored or written anywhere.

website.how: The site's title reads "Heather for House 20A"; the home page names Heather Arndt, speaks of the State Representative voters deserve, and is prepared and paid for by the Heather for House 20A Committee. It is the address filed with the Secretary of State.

endorsed_by.also: The party's page lists her as "Huldah Hiltsley, House District 38A", the name the state roster uses for the seat's holder.

website.how: The site's title reads "Brian Cohn for Minnesota House 57B, Lakeville" and says he is running to represent Lakeville in the Minnesota House. It is the address filed with the Secretary of State.

The home page reads "Jeff Gontarek, Otter Tail County Commissioner, District 2", gives the November 3, 2026 general election dates and is prepared and paid for by the Jeff Gontarek Campaign Committee. It is the address filed with the Secretary of State.

offices.also: The page lists "Jon Kangas, District 5" among the members and gives no start date.
